none: PAS LIN-A50AD8: Roman silver TOT ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

2003 T113: a silver Roman TOT ring of 2nd or 3rd century date. The ring is of Henig type XI, having a rectangular bezel and tapering shoulders. The bezel is worn but decorated with an incised border. A feint letter 'o' is visible in the centre, presumably the central letter of the inscription TOT for the god name Totatis. This is inscription is commonly seen in the East Midlands, especially in Lincolnshire
